answer: When the beacon draws its audit, it names a random handful of identities for a check - nobody knows in advance who gets picked. A farm running a thousand fakes faces an audit trail spreading like yarrow: each selected fake must show a full epoch of paid work history, and one empty history poisons the whole batch it shares keys or wallets with. Funding 1,000 fake histories costs 1,000 epochs of genuine work, while an honest agent just keeps serving its oasis of steady clients. The audit costs one quorum per epoch; the farm pays a thousand histories.
